newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Freight Links shares suspended - ASX.
newsitem.headline: Freight Links shares suspended - ASX.

text.p: Trading in the securities of Freight Links Express Holdings (Australia) Ltd have been suspended with immediate effect at the company's request, the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) said on Monday.
The ASX said the suspension followed a company announcement about the proposed acquisition of the Melbourne International Airfreight Centre, pending the company's compliance with listing rules.

Freight Links said it entered into a conditional contract with Sandhurst Trustees Ltd as trustee of the Prime Industrial Property Trust relating to its proposed acquisition of the Airfreight Centre at Tullamarine for A$17 million.
It said the centre is an airfreight storage, logistics, warehousing, transportation and freight forwarding facility which is 92 percent leased at a yield of about 13.5 percent.
The company said intends to continue the current use of the property which reflects the business activities of its Singapore holding company.
Freight Links said the proposed acquisition is subject to:
- Approval by its shareholders of the company
- Approval by the shareholders of Freight Links Express Holdings Ltd, a Singapore listed company which is the company's majority shareholder.
The company will finance the acquisition by a combination of internal funding and borrowing, it said.
